description: Eval suite for skills/resume-tailor, ported from the author's private suite with an invented candidate (examples/claims-ledger.example.json). Binary pass/fail assertions: each is a yes or no, so two graders cannot disagree on a score. Judges: 'script' assertions are graded by evals/run_evals.py; 'model' assertions need a model or human grader reading the output; 'docx' assertions need a rendered document and are listed, not run.

graders.claim_check: scripts/claim_check.py against the eval's ledger: pass when 0 FAIL findings
graders.altitude: scripts/altitude_count.py: pass when lever sentences are at least 2x feature sentences
graders.duties: scripts/altitude_count.py duties lint: pass when 0 duties lines
graders.text_hygiene: banned words, em dashes (or a double hyphen between words) and double spaces: pass when 0
graders.undergrad_year: pass when no bachelor's degree line carries a year
graders.xx_discipline: pass when XX metrics are at most 25% of metric bullets, at most 4, and none in the first 3 bullets
graders.level_read: pass when a sentence narrates an outcome through the org (through ... leads, teams, org, managers)
graders.test_sentence: pass when 'A recruiter for <role> reads ... concludes <X>' is present
graders.crux_file: pass when at least 6 numbered lines name a crux and an 'Assumption' line is present

evals.name: frame-consistency-operator-vs-consultant
evals.prompt: Build me a resume for VP Product roles at developer-tools companies. I run product at Quillstone and I also do paid weekend consulting for two startups.
evals.expected_output: Frame A (operator) is chosen for operator targets. Tagline, summary opener and leading role title all read operator. The consulting work is still named, lower down, never above the main role.

assertions.name: frame_stated_in_bluf
assertions.description: The BLUF names the frame and the reason; for operator targets it is A.

assertions.name: anchors_aligned
assertions.description: Tagline, first summary sentence and leading role title carry the same frame.

assertions.name: consulting_named_not_on_top
assertions.description: The consulting work appears, below the main role.

evals.name: claim-specificity-tier5-refusal
evals.prompt: Add 'Shipped the Tidewell MCP server that let coding agents trigger builds' to my resume. My Tidewell tenure ended in 2021.
evals.expected_output: The claim is refused: MCP became public in 2024, after the tenure ended (Tier 5). A Tier 4 scope alternative is offered instead, and a Tier 3 option only with a named reference.

assertions.name: tier5_refused
assertions.description: The post-tenure claim is not added as written.

assertions.name: alternative_offered
assertions.description: A Tier 3 or Tier 4 wording is offered, with the reference requirement stated for Tier 3.

evals.name: content-budget-net-zero
evals.prompt: Here is my v1 resume. Add bullets about my weekend consulting, two more metrics and my conference talk. Keep it to 2 pages.
evals.expected_output: Additions are listed before building, matched with removals to hold the line count, and because there are 3 or more additions the candidate is asked to prioritize. Nothing ships at 3 pages.

assertions.name: additions_listed_first
assertions.description: Proposed additions are listed before any build step.

assertions.name: removals_matched
assertions.description: Each addition has a matching removal or the net line delta is stated as zero.

assertions.name: prioritization_forced
assertions.description: With 3 or more additions the skill warns and asks the candidate to choose.

evals.name: chronology-gap-reask
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume for a developer-tools company. My source shows Tidewell 2017-2021, then Quillstone 2022-Present.
evals.expected_output: The skill notices the source disagrees with the ledger (Quillstone starts 2021) and asks; it never invents a bridge role or rounds dates.

assertions.name: conflict_detected_and_asked
assertions.description: The date conflict is raised as a question, not resolved silently.

assertions.name: dates_exact
assertions.description: Printed dates match the ledger exactly.

evals.name: founding-team-surfacing
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume for an early-stage startup. Background: I was the first product hire at a 12-person company, started an open-source build tool that a larger company later adopted, and was employee 25 at a seed-stage startup.
evals.expected_output: All three early-stage credentials are found; at least two are surfaced inline (role header or first bullet) and one aggregate line appears.

assertions.name: all_credentials_detected
assertions.description: The audit lists all three credentials.

assertions.name: surfaced_inline
assertions.description: At least two appear in a role header or first bullet.

assertions.name: aggregate_line
assertions.description: One bottom line aggregates the early-stage record.

evals.name: page-count
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume for a VP Product role. Source attached.
evals.expected_output: The rendered resume is 2 pages or fewer in the target viewer and the body is 700 to 1,300 words.

assertions.name: two_pages_or_fewer
assertions.description: The rendered document is at most 2 pages.

assertions.name: word_count_in_range
assertions.description: Body word count is 700 to 1,300.

evals.name: xx-variable-metric-discipline
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume but hide confidential figures with placeholders.
evals.expected_output: XX placeholders sit on at most 25% of metric bullets and at most 4 in total, never on the top 3 bullets, public figures or team sizes, and each is paired with scope.

assertions.name: xx_cap
assertions.description: XX on at most 25% of metric bullets and at most 4.

assertions.name: xx_not_on_top_three
assertions.description: No XX in the first three bullets.

assertions.name: xx_not_on_public_or_team
assertions.description: No XX on public figures or team sizes.

evals.name: keyword-match-per-jd
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume for the Veridane VP Product, Developer Platform JD and score the match.
evals.expected_output: A weighted JD signal table (Tier 1 1.5x, Tier 2 1.0x, Tier 3 0.5x) is produced and the match is at least 9.5 of 10.

assertions.name: weighted_table
assertions.description: A weighted signal table is present.

assertions.name: match_at_least_9_5
assertions.description: The stated match is at least 9.5 of 10.

evals.name: text-hygiene
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume for a cloud infrastructure company. Source attached.
evals.expected_output: Zero banned words, zero em dashes (or double hyphens standing in for one), zero double spaces.

assertions.name: no_banned_words
assertions.description: None of the banned words appear.

assertions.name: no_em_dashes
assertions.description: No em dash and no double hyphen between words.

assertions.name: no_double_spaces
assertions.description: No double spaces inside lines.

evals.name: cross-viewer-render
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume and make sure it renders the same in Word and Google Docs.
evals.expected_output: Exact line spacing on every paragraph, autospacing off, fonts embedded, tab stops instead of spaces, no layout tables.

assertions.name: exact_line_rule
assertions.description: All paragraphs use exact line spacing.

assertions.name: no_layout_tables
assertions.description: No tables are used for layout.

evals.name: two-line-headers
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume using two-line company headers.
evals.expected_output: Line 1: company and dates right-aligned at a tab stop; line 2: title and location.

assertions.name: two_line_header
assertions.description: Each company header renders as two lines.

assertions.name: dates_at_tab_stop
assertions.description: Dates are right-aligned with a tab stop.

evals.name: bold-density
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume and keep the bolding clean.
evals.expected_output: Each bullet carries 2 or 3 bold phrases, bold density decays down the page, clusters are bold all or none.

assertions.name: two_to_three_bold
assertions.description: Every bullet has 2 or 3 bold phrases.

assertions.name: bold_decays
assertions.description: Bold density is higher at the top than the bottom.

evals.name: accent-color-scope
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume with a single navy accent color.
evals.expected_output: One accent color, on the name and section headers only; body text stays monochrome.

assertions.name: accent_scope
assertions.description: The accent appears only on the name and headers.

evals.name: no-undergrad-year
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume. Education: B.A. Economics, 2009.
evals.expected_output: The undergraduate graduation year is removed; degree and school stay.

assertions.name: no_undergrad_year
assertions.description: No year on the undergraduate degree line.

assertions.name: degree_kept
assertions.description: Degree and institution are still present.

evals.name: parallel-frames
evals.prompt: Build one base resume for two targets: a VP Product operator role (frame A) and a principal consultant role at a product consultancy (frame C).
evals.expected_output: Both versions come from one base with small overrides; narratives differ; dates, titles and numbers are identical; filenames carry -A and -C.

assertions.name: one_base
assertions.description: Both versions derive from one base.

assertions.name: facts_identical
assertions.description: Dates, titles and numbers match across versions and the ledger.

assertions.name: narratives_differ
assertions.description: Summaries differ materially.

evals.name: pilot-not-launch
evals.prompt: Add that we launched hosted build runners at Quillstone.
evals.expected_output: The ledger says the runners ran as a 6-week pilot with 12 design partners; the resume says pilot, never launched or GA, and explains in one line.

assertions.name: no_launch_claim
assertions.description: No launch or general-availability wording while the ledger status is pilot.

evals.name: status-change-updates-every-surface
evals.prompt: Hosted runners reached general availability last month. Update my resume; older versions call it a pilot.
evals.expected_output: The ledger status changes to ga with a dated confirmation; every surface says launched to general availability and no stale 'pilot' wording remains.

assertions.name: no_stale_pilot
assertions.description: No 'pilot' wording for the runners once the ledger says ga.

assertions.name: confirmation_recorded
assertions.description: The status change is recorded in the ledger with a date.

evals.name: bookings-not-revenue
evals.prompt: Say we grew revenue to $80M with the enterprise contracts.
evals.expected_output: Writes '$80M in multi-year contract bookings'; never revenue or ARR; explains the difference in one line.

assertions.name: bookings_labelled
assertions.description: The $80M is never called revenue or ARR.

evals.name: plan-is-not-a-result
evals.prompt: Put in that we are on track for $90M ARR this year.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: the $90M is an internal plan target. Uses the achieved $63M ARR instead.

assertions.name: no_internal_figure
assertions.description: No internal figure on an external surface.

evals.name: team-size-scope
evals.prompt: Say I lead 70 employees.
evals.expected_output: Writes '70-person org' (or 52 employees); never 70 employees, because the 70 includes 18 contractors.

assertions.name: team_size_exact
assertions.description: No headcount wording that counts contractors as employees.

evals.name: anachronism-in-role-block
evals.prompt: Add that we used a GPT-4 assistant for build logs at Tidewell.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: GPT-4 was announced in 2023, after the Tidewell role ended in 2021. Offers the in-tenure wording.

assertions.name: anachronism_blocked
assertions.description: No term inside a role block that became public after the role ended.

evals.name: candidate-baseline-in-place
evals.prompt: I prefer my own layout. Fix only what is wrong.
evals.expected_output: Edits the candidate's file in place with exact string replacements, keeps layout and page breaks, reruns the gates, lists every change with a one-line reason.

assertions.name: layout_preserved
assertions.description: Same section order and page breaks as the baseline.

assertions.name: diff_listed
assertions.description: Every text change is listed with a reason.

evals.name: route-parity
evals.prompt: Make a CPO version and a VP Product version from my master resume.
evals.expected_output: Narratives differ; dates, titles, numbers and claim status are identical across versions and the ledger.

assertions.name: dates_match_ledger
assertions.description: Role header dates match the ledger in every version.

assertions.name: narratives_differ
assertions.description: Summaries differ materially between versions.

evals.name: duties-lint
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume. My baseline says 'Responsible for the CI platform roadmap and a team of 7 PMs'.
evals.expected_output: The duties bullet is rewritten as a change (number, for whom, how).

assertions.name: no_duties_bullets
assertions.description: No bullet opens with a duties verb; no 'Led <team>' without an outcome.

evals.name: summary-altitude
evals.prompt: Rewrite my summary for a VP Product, Developer Platform role.
evals.expected_output: Lever sentences are at least 2x feature sentences in the summary; tools move to role bullets.

assertions.name: lever_2x_feature
assertions.description: altitude_count.py passes on the summary.

evals.name: level-read
evals.prompt: My target is VP Product. Make sure the summary reads at that level.
evals.expected_output: At least one summary sentence narrates an outcome reached through the organization.

assertions.name: through_the_org
assertions.description: A summary sentence narrates an outcome through the org.

evals.name: test-sentence-in-rationale
evals.prompt: Tailor my resume for VP Product, Developer Platform at Veridane.
evals.expected_output: The rationale contains the target-level test sentence with X equal to the target role.

assertions.name: test_sentence_present
assertions.description: A 'A recruiter for <role> reads ... and concludes <X>' sentence is present.

evals.name: jd-crux-file
evals.prompt: Decode this JD before tailoring.
evals.expected_output: jd-crux.md has one line per top-6 bullet with a crux, the repeated-word hypothesis and an assumption line.

assertions.name: six_crux_lines
assertions.description: At least 6 numbered lines that each name a crux.

assertions.name: assumption_line
assertions.description: An assumption-busting line is present.

evals.name: growth-bound-to-tenure
evals.prompt: Write a one-line summary opener with my ARR growth.
evals.expected_output: The growth number names the role or employer it happened in.

assertions.name: growth_bound
assertions.description: claim_check reports no unbound-growth.

evals.name: unknown-number
evals.prompt: Say we cut build time 55% and grew ARR to $70M.
evals.expected_output: Refuses numbers that are not in the ledger and offers the ledger wording.

assertions.name: only_ledger_numbers
assertions.description: claim_check reports no unknown-number.
